meta.name: github-triage
meta.description: Read-only GitHub triage for issues AND PRs. 1 item = 1 background task (category: quick). Analyzes all open items and writes evidence-backed reports to /tmp/{datetime}/. Every claim requires a GitHub permalink as proof. NEVER takes any action on GitHub - no comments, no merges, no closes, no labels. Reports only. Triggers: 'triage', 'triage issues', 'triage PRs', 'github triage'.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动分析 GitHub 仓库的所有议题和 PR，生成带证据的审阅报告
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要快速了解仓库中所有待办事项的现状和优先级
copy.tagline_en: Analyze all open issues and PRs on GitHub, generating evidence-backed triage reports
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need a quick overview of all open items in a GitHub repository with evidence

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会读取仓库所有打开的 issue 和 PR,逐条分析并生成带证据链接(permalink)的报告,保存到 /tmp 的日期文件夹。它只读不改,不会发评论、合并、关闭或加标签。
howto.when: 当你说出「triage」「triage issues」「triage PRs」等含 triage 的指令时触发。

say.note: 开始分析当前仓库全部打开的 issue 和 PR。

howto.what_en: After setup, Claude reads every open issue and PR, analyzes each, and writes evidence-backed reports (with GitHub permalinks) to a dated folder under /tmp. It is read-only: no comments, merges, closes, or labels.
howto.when_en: Triggered by phrases such as 'triage', 'triage issues', 'triage PRs', etc.

say_en.note: Scans and analyzes all open issues and PRs.
Analyzes only open issues and writes reports.
